text: {"label":"Olfactory and Stimulus Discrimination in Rodents","definition":"Laboratory studies of discrimination learning in rats and mice, often using odor stimuli: conditional and relational discrimination, functional equivalence classes, reversal learning, stimulus prevalence, generalization, and odor-detection training.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike general rat operant conditioning, it centres on rodent discrimination and odor-based stimulus control, rather than human stimulus control or conceptual work on stimulus equivalence formation."}
